newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hibernia said raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hibernia said raised.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs raised its rating on Hibernia Corp to recommended from market perform, a Goldman source said.
-- Goldman raised its rating on Comerica Inc, Firstar Corp and Southern National Corp to recommend from outperform, the source said.
-- Further details were not immediately available.
-- Hibernia was up 1/8 at 11-1/8, Comerica was down 3/8 at 48-3/6, Firstar was down 1/8 at 47-1/8 and Southern National was down 5/8 at 30-5/8.
